newsitem.title: GERMANY: Agiv halts due-diligence in sale to MG.
newsitem.headline: Agiv halts due-diligence in sale to MG.

text.p: German industrial holding company AGIV has decided to halt the due-diligence process associated with the sale of a 49.9 percent stake in the group held by BHF Bank to Metallgesellschaft AG (MG), MG said on Wednesday.
In a statement, MG said that despite AGIV's decision, MG and BHF bank wanted to carry out the AGIV sale and were seeking to find a solution.
BHF Bank also released an identical statement.
The two companies said in their statements that the study had been halted due to negative press reports.
The AGIV board had given the impression that the study was aimed at pushing down the price of the stake.
